ziwei_chart_packaging.scope: Application jar and test-only launcher in a temporary working directory; no Python process or fixture classpath

ziwei_runtime_packaging.scope: Real deployment image, production runtime and PostgreSQL; synthetic model in external test launcher only

live_validator_contract_tests.scope: Offline validator contracts; no real model or remote API

drain_preflight_contract_tests.scope: offline fixtures, loopback HTTP and local CLI; no real deployment or provider

restore_privacy_contract_tests.scope: offline synthetic snapshots and local CLI; SQL execution is validated separately in Compose

validation_scope: Local PostgreSQL, pgvector and independent JVMs; native loopback model/MCP/Feishu adapters; M6 date contracts, calendar compatibility, 2524 full chart comparisons, domain facts and focus parity, native Toolkit suspension/resume, scoped artifacts, HMAC, budgets and privacy. M6d packaged process crash recovery, cancellation/privacy competition, deployment image with five native tools and no Python, offline live-validator contracts. Development gate retained: no real model Ziwei selection, real provider/MCP/Feishu tenant or remote CI execution. Compose validation is recorded separately. M5b owner-scoped admission pause/resume, revision and idempotency receipts, PostgreSQL submission/pause races, existing approval/input/cancellation and Feishu continuity, drain counts including uncertain effects, notification and memory backlogs. M5c read-only owner-scoped keyset pages for task, notification, unprojected binding and memory job blockers; terminal-turn residual facts, numeric job ordering, foreign-owner exclusion and content minimization. M5d adds only delivery tooling: read-only operations API observations, inventory/count comparison, incomplete scan handling and private report files. The Java build inputs and jar retain their M5c full-suite validation. Preflight fixtures and loopback HTTP/CLI contracts ran separately; deployed CLI observations are in Compose evidence. M5e adds offline all-owner privacy snapshot comparison and a read-only SQL snapshot query. Java inputs remain unchanged; SQL and pre-forget backup isolation are exercised separately in Compose. Matching supplied snapshots does not prove reference freshness or authorize production recovery.
